rows.text: As fellow Intellitron siblings from Planet Screwllum, we've got a lot in common to talk about.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Correction: My offer to work together is on my own behalf, not the IPC's.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Not too long ago, I came to an agreement with Madam Pearl: for the next research cycle in the Simulated Universe, I'll add her to the list of collaborators. In return, she'll provide some computational support.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Correction: This project only uses elements related to Phantasmoon Games for presentation purposes and does not possess any actual efficacy.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Due to limited reference materials, we're not planning to add this feature for now.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Madam Herta had no objections to the proposal. After the battle with Irontomb, she's been actively searching for effective countermeasures against the Destruction, like advancing the practical application of Imaginary Pulse technology. This project could prove helpful.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: How exactly Wishpower forms and influences the game remains a mystery. Conclusion: An excellent choice for a research topic.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Negative. A genius doesn't lack wealth, and Miss Pearl knows she needs to show more sincerity.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: The specifics still need to be refined, but I can point you in a direction: Those who possess Path Energy aren't necessarily Pathstriders.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: One thing is affirmative. Miss Pearl has her own agenda when it comes to these Phantasmoon Games. But at least on a professional level, she's a reliable partner to work with.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: ...systems running smoothly. Conclusion: My computational power has improved the Simulated Universe's response speed by 3.7%.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} [Trailblazer], your timing is impeccable. My optimism about this collaboration just increased by 7.3%.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Pearl's here too.
Is the IPC finally making a move on the Simulated Universe?
We've added Wishpower as a key variable to the new version of the Simulated Universe, while also increasing the calculation weight for the Path of Elation.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Considering that the ongoing Phantasmoon Games are a manifestation of the Aeon of Elation, this curriculum update will be presented in a similar fashion. Note: It incorporates collective impressions from modern online culture, so accuracy is not guaranteed.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Do we seriously have to play Phantasmoon Games in the Simulated Universe too?
If I win, do I get to meet Aha?
Did you ask Herta what she thinks?
Besides, the IPC's records on the "traditional" Phantasmoon Games from before Planarcadia's Canvas Age are pretty spotty. Researching Wishpower will also help me carry out my duties more effectively.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No time like the present. Why don't you give it a try yourself, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: No systemic aberrations detected. Looks like this framework based on Wishpower can indeed couple perfectly with a Path-rooted architecture.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Hypothesis: If the emotions of organic life are likened to tides, then Wishpower is the spray that splashes up. Conclusion: A Supplicant's acquisition of Wishpower shares similarities with sentient life's faith in Aeons.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Now that Mr. Screwllum has finished the inspection, it's time for me to head back to Pearluxe Tower. I hope we can stay in touch and collaborate more in the future.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Did Pearl launch a credit offensive on you too?
What does that conclusion mean?
Beyond the Phantasmoon Games, ceremonies of Elation exist throughout the universe, like the Devil Hunt on Vonwacq, or the Eternal Race on Twin-Sided Planet...
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: These ceremonies follow no unified rules and offer no set rewards, yet they constantly stir up ripples across the Paths throughout the universe. Hypothesis: They're explorations of the boundaries of Elation.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Keep coming back for tests as usual. I've still got some conjectures I need to verify.
rows.speaker: Screwllum
